Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Phylus Mon]] led an '''incursion''' into the [[Almas Sith fortress|abandoned Sith fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. Mon sought to both recover the secrets of the creation of [[Sith battlelord]]s and to perform repairs to the [[Darkstaff]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] entrusted to his care by the criminal [[Len Markus]], and accompanied by his [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] ally [[Karae Nalvas]] and several of his minions, Mon attacked six [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who had been stationed to stand guard outside the fortress. The Chevin and his associates [[Death/Legends|killed]] four of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Tresten Agai'i]], [[K'kur]], [[Milak Sonloam]] and [[Vorlocca]], and took the other two guardians&mdash;the [[Tarasin]] [[Constanten (Tarasin)|Constanten]] and the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] [[Valiri]]&mdash;as captives. Mon then made his way into the depths of the fortress and recovered a tome that detailed the rituals through which battlelords could be created.<ref name="AMA" />
